## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, ...) — it becomes the squash-merge commit title and feeds the changelog
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic`, and `cargo nextest run --all-targets` all pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change (or N/A, with reason below)
- [ ] Public-facing behavior change is reflected in `README.md` and/or doc comments (or N/A)
